features: Three selectable champions: Void Warden starting character, Frost Sentinel unlocked after 40 total completed-run defeats, and Ember Reaver unlocked after reaching Wave 4 in a completed run.
Character choices grant real starting combat stats and visual character identities: Frost Sentinel defensive tank, Ember Reaver glass-cannon offense, and balanced Void Warden.
Renown currency earned on completed survival runs from score, enemies, elites, waves and boss defeats; no reward farming from abandoned runs.
Four permanent forgeable relics: Nightglass Edge, Moonwell Sigil, Phantom Spurs and Soul Chalice; two active relic loadout slots.
Full cinematic Ascension Armory screen with class preview cards, lock goals, forge purchases, equipment toggles and live Renown balance.
New run results with earned Renown and expanded Hall of Legends Renown lifetime total; Warden's Codex now shows selected champion and equipped relics.
Persistent independent localStorage progression and backward-compatible prior score/wave/kill records, no accounts or cloud access.
Warbound UI, Nightfall Hexers, Ravagers, elites, rifts and four realms, PWA offline play, iPhone controls and Proximus personal media are preserved.
privacy: Scores only in this game's localStorage; no access to Asset Alchemist video files.
